sources.series_c: BusinessWire 2026-04-30: Netomi Raises $110M (Accenture Ventures lead); Reuters 2026-04-30

facts: Netomi is an enterprise agentic AI platform for customer experience (CX); a no-code platform for building, testing, deploying, and monitoring AI agents (build/train/test/deploy/monitor lifecycle).

Works with global brands including Delta Air Lines, United Airlines, MetLife, MGM Resorts, DraftKings, NBA, Paramount, Ingram Micro, WestJet, Brex, SodaStream, Equinox, Virgin Voyages, Coach; powers the United Airlines Chat AI in the United mobile app.
Founded 2015 by CEO Puneet Mehta; headquartered San Mateo, California; offices in New York, Toronto, and India; roughly 170 employees.

Raised $110M Series C (announced April 30, 2026) led by Accenture Ventures with Adobe Ventures, WndrCo, NAVER Ventures, Metis Strategy, and Fin Capital; more than $160M raised in total; early backers include Greg Brockman, Demis Hassabis, Mustafa Suleyman; Jeffrey Katzenberg joined the board.
Uses AI models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google to handle customer queries.
Named a Gartner Cool Vendor; recipient of a 2021 AI Breakthrough Award.
Posting bands the India remote front-end role at 18-20 LPA (posting fact only; never claim in letters).

Posting requirements: 1-3 years building UI-heavy features for a B2B SaaS application; mastery of JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3; React (posting says Vue.js or React or Angular); REST and Web Hooks knowledge; NodeJS backend experience is a plus; B.E./B.Tech in CS or related.

Posting responsibilities: ownership of key UI modules, front-end build and test systems, translating designs into high-quality code, reusable components and front-end libraries, API implementation with backend/data science/devops.
